recognize_zh: 淋巴結濾泡間區充滿大量增生的小血管，內皮細胞肥厚突出，並夾雜紅血球外滲；畫面中央可見小淋巴球呈同心圓（洋蔥皮樣）排列包圍萎縮、玻璃樣變的生發中心。
features: Marked interfollicular vascular proliferation of small capillaries and venules
Plump, prominent endothelial cells lining numerous vessels
Regressed follicle with concentric onion-skin layering of small mantle lymphocytes around a hyalinized center
Interspersed small lymphocytes, scattered plasma cells and extravasated red blood cells
Effaced-appearing, hypervascular architecture without sheets of atypical large cells
describe_en: Lymph node section at 20x shows a hypervascular interfollicular region with numerous proliferating small vessels lined by plump endothelial cells, accompanied by small lymphocytes, occasional plasma cells and extravasated red cells. A regressed follicle is present centrally, with small mantle lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers around a hyalinized, depleted germinal center. There is no infiltrate of atypical large cells. Findings are consistent with the hypervascular variant of Castleman disease-like histology, as described in TAFRO syndrome.

ddx.vs: AITL also shows arborizing high endothelial venules, but it contains clusters of atypical clear T cells expressing CD10/PD-1/CXCL13 and expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks around vessels, with clonal TCR rearrangement.
Morphology overlaps, but unicentric disease presents as a solitary mass without systemic inflammation, thrombocytopenia, anasarca or organomegaly.
Kaposi sarcoma forms fascicles of spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces and hyaline globules that are HHV-8 LANA-1 positive.
